in_sanskrit.name: जयान्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जय (jaya) - victory, अन्त (anta) - end, स्वरूप (svarupa) - essence. So, Jayanta means one who is the embodiment of victory or invincible.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jayanta has deep roots in Hinduism. It is said that the name resonates with the divine energies of the gods Indra and Vishnu, who are believed to bestow victory and triumph upon their devotees. The name is also associated with the concept of 'jay' or spiritual victory, which refers to the victories that come from within, such as overcoming negative emotions and achieving inner peace and enlightenment.
